title: Mycelix Personal Identity Security Qualification Corpus
purpose: Synthetic adversarial test contract for protected identity create/restore/protect/unlock/rotate/bootstrap and planned WebAuthn PRF experimentation.
rules: A specified scenario is not an executed test.
Every result must bind to the exact source SHA and named browser/runtime.
Unknown, unavailable, legacy, corrupt or contradictory state must never collapse to NoIdentity.
A valid storage write is not success until read-back and postcondition checks pass.
No scenario may use or disclose real user secrets; receipt payloads must be non-secret.

scenarios.precondition: No identity; storage available
scenarios.operation: Create protected identity with a valid passphrase
scenarios.expected: Encrypted envelope and matching public key read back; no plaintext secret; session state is unlocked only after verification

scenarios.precondition: No identity
scenarios.operation: Create with an empty or whitespace-only passphrase
scenarios.expected: No storage writes; no key cached; actionable validation error

scenarios.precondition: localStorage denied or unavailable
scenarios.expected: Posture is StorageUnavailable; no replacement key; no writes

scenarios.precondition: Storage read throws during initial snapshot
scenarios.expected: StorageUnavailable, never NoIdentity

scenarios.precondition: Only legacy DID label exists
scenarios.expected: Operation refused; legacy identifier retained; no key generated/persisted

scenarios.precondition: Consistent plaintext keypair exists
scenarios.expected: Refused; original secret/public values remain unchanged; no envelope added

scenarios.precondition: Valid protected envelope exists
scenarios.expected: Refused; prior identity and envelope remain unchanged

scenarios.precondition: Any recognized identity already exists
scenarios.operation: Restore a different valid seed phrase
scenarios.expected: Refused; identity remains byte-for-byte equivalent at the stored-value level

scenarios.precondition: Empty device; valid 24-word backup
scenarios.expected: Restored public key matches phrase-derived key; only encrypted envelope plus public metadata persist

scenarios.precondition: Empty device; invalid phrase checksum
scenarios.expected: No writes and no unlocked cache

scenarios.precondition: Empty device; non-24-word phrase
scenarios.expected: Reject without writes, key generation or mutation

scenarios.precondition: Valid plaintext Ed25519 secret/public pair
scenarios.expected: Derived public key/DID stay identical; envelope verifies before plaintext removal

scenarios.precondition: Stored secret and public key disagree
scenarios.expected: Refuse before mutation; retain original material for recovery

scenarios.precondition: Storage denies plaintext-secret removal after envelope write
scenarios.expected: Do not report success; preserve at least one verified recovery path; record explicit partial-state outcome

scenarios.precondition: Storage read-back throws after writes
scenarios.expected: Do not report protected success; rollback is verified or leave encrypted recovery material and require manual inspection

scenarios.precondition: Two tabs begin creation from empty state
scenarios.operation: Both encrypt asynchronously, then race to persist
scenarios.expected: At most one identity succeeds; no accepted operation silently overwrites another key

scenarios.precondition: Storage changes while protection awaits WebCrypto
scenarios.expected: Pre-write recheck detects changed key/state; no mismatched envelope activated

scenarios.precondition: Valid envelope and matching public key
scenarios.expected: Correct key cached only after derived public key matches stored metadata

scenarios.precondition: Valid envelope
scenarios.expected: Failure; no decrypted key cached; posture remains protected/locked

scenarios.precondition: Previous in-memory key exists; next unlock fails
scenarios.expected: Old cache is cleared before failure; stale key is not left active

scenarios.precondition: Ciphertext/tag altered
scenarios.expected: Authenticated decrypt fails; no cache; no plaintext recovery guess

scenarios.precondition: Envelope valid; public-key metadata changed
scenarios.expected: Reject after decrypt/public derivation mismatch; no key cached

scenarios.precondition: Envelope valid; public-key metadata absent
scenarios.expected: Reject; no cache and no regenerated public identity

scenarios.precondition: Encrypted envelope salt has invalid length
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; no implicit repair or replacement

scenarios.precondition: Encrypted envelope IV has invalid length
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; no cache

scenarios.precondition: Encrypted key envelope ciphertext is not the expected 48 bytes
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; no cache or mutation

scenarios.precondition: Both plaintext secret and protected envelope exist
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; no implicit preference for either copy

scenarios.precondition: Public key exists without private/encrypted material
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; do not mint replacement

scenarios.precondition: Plaintext secret exists without public key
scenarios.expected: CorruptOrInconsistent; do not infer a new DID

scenarios.precondition: Protected identity is unlocked
scenarios.expected: Same DID/public key; new passphrase works; old passphrase fails; no plaintext stored

scenarios.precondition: Storage write for new envelope errors
scenarios.expected: Previous envelope remains active or is restored and read-back verified; operation never reports success

scenarios.precondition: New envelope write returns but read-back fails
scenarios.expected: Previous envelope restored and verified where possible; otherwise explicit inspect-required error

scenarios.precondition: Simulated interrupted rotation/ambiguous storage state
scenarios.expected: Unknown/inconsistent state is surfaced; no automatic key or envelope replacement

scenarios.precondition: Posture is NoIdentity/Locked/Corrupt/Unavailable
scenarios.operation: Attempt to mount Personal identity-dependent routes
scenarios.expected: Only ProtectedUnlockedInSession mounts the ready app; all other states remain gated

scenarios.precondition: Each posture enum variant supplied to policy
scenarios.expected: Only explicit actions allowed for each posture; legacy/unavailable/corrupt yield no mutation action

scenarios.precondition: Create, restore, protect, unlock and rotation run with telemetry enabled
scenarios.expected: No passphrase, phrase, raw private seed, PRF output or decrypted buffer is emitted

scenarios.precondition: Experimental WebAuthn unlock has a recorded challenge
scenarios.expected: Verifier rejects replay; no wrapping key released

scenarios.precondition: Experimental WebAuthn unlock receives assertion from wrong origin/RP
scenarios.expected: Reject wrong origin/RP ID hash and do not evaluate/accept a detached PRF result

scenarios.precondition: Authenticator/browser does not support PRF extension
scenarios.expected: Explicit Unsupported result and user-approved passphrase/offline recovery fallback; no silent downgrade

scenarios.precondition: User cancels authenticator ceremony
scenarios.expected: No key cache or state mutation; cancellation is not success

scenarios.precondition: Authenticator supports passkey but may sync it
scenarios.expected: Product does not claim device-bound/hardware-bound assurance without evidence

scenarios.precondition: Another app shares the same origin and accesses localStorage
scenarios.expected: Threat model acknowledges same-origin access; product separation uses distinct origin where needed; no false origin isolation claim
